name: My Heart to Take
source:
Sorah stumbles on a portal that pulls her into an alternate world - one that needs her heart to survive. Now, she has just a few short weeks to save her own life, or the life of the other world. But maybe, with the help of one of the men she meets - Lanslod, the heroic knight, Ogier, the kind and intelligent royal advisor, Lahire, the fun-loving and resourceful court Jester, or Hekter, the determined and domineering King - she can find a way to save both.

[From [url=https://applesplosion.itch.io/my-heart-to-take]Itch.io[/url]]
